high_level_description: stc brand style, a dramatic landscape photograph of a circular sun setting behind a mountain range.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A sky transitioning from deep golden orange near the sun to darker amber tones with scattered wispy clouds, shot in a cinematic aspect ratio with black letterboxing.

A completely black, layered mountain range silhouette with multiple peaks across the bottom third of the image.
